دُجَةٌ The three fingers [meaning the thumb and first and second fingers] with a mouthful upon [or between] them. (K.) And The mouthful [that is taken with the thumb and first and second fingers]. (TA.) ثَلَاثُ دُجَةٍ يَحْمِلْنَ دُجَةً إِلَى الغَيْهَبَانِ وَالمِنْثَجَةِ is an enigma of the Arabs of the desert, meaning Three fingers conveying a mouthful to the belly and the anus. (TA.) ＝
-A2- A button (T, M, K) of a shirt: (T, K:) pl. دُجَاتٌ and دُجًى. (K.) ―
-b2- See also art. دجى.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
